message.content:
Here are the visual differences between the original (Image 1) and the clone (Image 2):

*   **Top Right User Badge:** The text in the yellow circle changed from **"SE"** to **"DE"**.
*   **Site Selector Dropdown:** The text inside the dropdown menu at the top right changed from **"second-test-..."** to **"demo-store.example.c..."**.
*   **Code Snippet Content:**
    *   The `s.src` URL changed from a Supabase function URL (`...supabase.co/functions/v1/pixel'`) to a localhost URL (`'http://localhost:3000/pixel.js'`).
    *   The unique pixel ID string at the end of the script changed from `'px_cfdff430f45b04c6'` to `'px_5b41ab65df14e9d5'`.
*   **Status Alert Box (Below Code):**
    *   The icon changed from a **clock/loading spinner** to a **checkmark circle**.
    *   The background color appears slightly more saturated/green-tinted in the clone.
    *   The text changed from "Waiting for first event..." to **"Pixel verified! We're receiving data from demo-store.example.com. Everything is working."**
*   **Platform Instructions Tabs:** In Image 1, the tabs are displayed inline within a light gray container. In Image 2, the **"HTML / Custom" tab looks like an active/selected button** with a white background and shadow, while the other tabs are grayed out.
*   **Bottom Left Footer:** A large, dark circular avatar with the letter **"N"** is overlaid on top of the "FREE" usage box and the "Sign out" link in the bottom left corner.
